A sum of money doubles itself at compound interest in 3 years. In how many years will it become 8 times?
questions.explanation: If principal doubles in 3 years: 2x in 3 years, 4x in 6 years, 8x in 9 years.

questions.q: The cost price of 20 articles is equal to the selling price of 16 articles. The profit percentage is:
questions.explanation: CP of 20 = SP of 16. Profit on 16 articles = CP of 4 articles. Profit% = (4/16)×100 = 25%.

questions.q: A pipe can fill a tank in 12 hours. Another pipe can empty it in 8 hours. If both are opened, in how many hours will the tank be empty (assuming it was full)?
questions.explanation: Net emptying rate = 1/8 − 1/12 = 3/24 − 2/24 = 1/24 per hour. Tank empties in 24 hours.

questions.q: If sin θ = 3/5, then cos θ =
questions.explanation: Using Pythagoras: if sin θ = 3/5, then opposite=3, hypotenuse=5, adjacent=4. cos θ = 4/5.

questions.q: The price of an article is cut by 10%. To restore it to the original price, the new price must be increased by:
questions.explanation: If original price = 100, new price = 90. To get back to 100: increase = 10/90 × 100 = 11.11%.

questions.q: What is 15% of 80% of 200?
Pointing towards a girl, Ramesh says 'She is the daughter of the only child of my grandfather.' How is the girl related to Ramesh?
questions.explanation: The only child of Ramesh's grandfather is Ramesh's parent. The girl is the daughter of Ramesh's parent — she is Ramesh's sister.

questions.q: Complete the series: QPO, NML, KJI, ?
questions.explanation: Each group of 3 letters goes in reverse order, with each group starting 3 letters earlier: QPO, NML, KJI, HGF.

questions.q: If CAT = 3120 and DOG = 4157, what is BAT?
questions.explanation: Each letter is replaced by its position number: C=3, A=1, T=20 → 3120. B=2, A=1, T=20 → 2120.

questions.q: The day before yesterday was Saturday. What day will be after tomorrow?
questions.explanation: Day before yesterday = Saturday → Yesterday = Sunday → Today = Monday → Tomorrow = Tuesday → Day after tomorrow = Wednesday.

questions.q: Which one is different? Apple, Guava, Mango, Rose
questions.explanation: Apple, Guava, and Mango are fruits. Rose is a flower — the odd one out.

questions.q: Book : Reading :: Pen : ?
questions.explanation: A book is used for reading; a pen is used for writing.

questions.q: The first railway line in India was inaugurated in which year?
questions.explanation: India's first passenger railway line ran between Bori Bunder (Mumbai) and Thane, inaugurated on April 16, 1853.

questions.q: The term 'Oligopoly' refers to:
questions.explanation: Oligopoly is a market structure dominated by a small number of large sellers who have significant market power.

questions.q: Swarna Jayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana was restructured as:
questions.explanation: SGSY (Swarna Jayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana) was restructured in 2011 as NRLM (National Rural Livelihood Mission), also known as Aajeevika.

questions.q: The 'Great Barrier Reef' is located in:
questions.explanation: The Great Barrier Reef, the world's largest coral reef system, is located in the Coral Sea off the coast of Australia (Pacific Ocean).

questions.q: Which element has the highest electronegativity?
questions.explanation: Fluorine has the highest electronegativity (3.98 on the Pauling scale) of all elements.

questions.q: The Rajya Sabha can have a maximum of how many members?
questions.explanation: The Rajya Sabha can have a maximum of 250 members — 238 elected from states/UTs + 12 nominated by the President. Currently it has 245 members.

questions.q: IRCTC stands for:
options: Indian Railway Catering and Travel Corporation
Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation
Indian Rail Commerce and Tourism Corporation
Indian Railway Commerce and Travel Corporation
questions.explanation: IRCTC stands for Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation, a subsidiary of Indian Railways.

questions.q: The pH value of pure water is:
questions.explanation: Pure water is neutral with a pH of exactly 7 at 25°C.
